scripts.lint:app: if [ -d apps/app/src ]; then oxlint --deny-warnings apps/app; else echo 'skip lint:app — apps/app not scaffolded yet (M8)'; fi
scripts.lint: bun run lint:server && bun run lint:app
scripts.typecheck:app: if [ -d apps/app/src ]; then bun --cwd apps/app x tsc --noEmit; else echo 'skip typecheck:app — apps/app not scaffolded yet (M8)'; fi
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:server && bun run typecheck:app
scripts.check: bun run format && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run docs:links && bun run test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait db && bun run apps/api/src/db/migrate.ts && bun run apps/api/src/db/seed.ts
scripts.check:ci: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run docs:links && bun run test
